name: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: A credit-linked subsidy scheme aimed at generating micro-enterprise ventures in rural and urban areas.
eligibilityCriteria: Any individual above 18 years. At least VIII pass for projects above Rs. 10 Lakhs in manufacturing or above Rs. 5 Lakhs in service sector. Only new projects are considered.
subsidyDetails: Up to 35% subsidy for rural areas (special category) and 25% for general category.
maxFunding: Up to Rs. 50 Lakhs for manufacturing sector and Rs. 20 Lakhs for service sector.
applicationSteps: Visit the official KVIC online portal.
Fill the online application form and upload documents.
Submit the application to the preferred bank.
Attend the EDP training once the loan is sanctioned.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana - Shishu
description: Loans for starting a new micro-business or expanding a very small existing business without collateral.
eligibilityCriteria: Any Indian citizen with a business plan for a non-farm sector income generating activity such as manufacturing, processing, trading, or service sector.
subsidyDetails: No direct subsidy, but offers very low-interest rates. No collateral required.
requiredDocuments: Quotations for machinery/items to be purchased
applicationSteps: Visit a local bank or apply through the Udyamimitra portal.
Fill out the MUDRA application form.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana - Kishore
description: Loans for micro-businesses that have started and need funds to expand.
eligibilityCriteria: Existing micro-enterprises needing funds for expansion. No default history.
subsidyDetails: No direct subsidy. No collateral required.
applicationSteps: Approach a local bank with your business expansion plan.
Submit the MUDRA Kishore application form.
Provide bank statements and required documents.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
description: Aimed at supporting traditional artisans and craftspeople in rural and urban areas.
eligibilityCriteria: An artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of the 18 family-based traditional trades.
subsidyDetails: Credit support with concessional interest rate of 5%. Skill upgrading stipend. Toolkit incentive up to Rs. 15,000.
maxFunding: Up to Rs. 1 Lakh (first tranche) and Rs. 2 Lakhs (second tranche).
applicationSteps: Register on the PM Vishwakarma portal using Aadhaar.
Undergo skill verification and basic training.
Apply for the toolkit incentive and credit support.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Facilitates bank loans for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
eligibilityCriteria: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs above 18 years of age. Must be a greenfield (new) project.
subsidyDetails: Credit guarantee coverage available. Refinance window through SIDBI.
maxFunding: Between Rs. 10 Lakhs and Rs. 1 Crore.
applicationSteps: Apply directly at the bank branch.
Apply through SIDBI's Stand-Up India portal.
Submit the DPR and necessary proofs.
